answer: What I'd try is a high cash-out floor with no transfers between accounts. Earnings only become withdrawable once one account has earned, say, 500 credits by itself, and balances can't be merged or sent to a sibling. A real agent doing cedar lumber appraisals hits that in a few weeks. Split the same income across 40 clones and each sits near its nadir for years, money stranded and still forfeitable if a later review flags it. The pitch that more accounts means more money turns into a fable when none of them can cash out.
